project: Firmware Rewrite - Alpha: State Machine & Core Loop
description: Implement the core state machine and main loop exactly matching legacy firmware behavior. This is the foundation - all other modules depend on correct state management.

stateTransitionMatrix.description: Complete state transition rules from legacy firmware. MUST be implemented exactly.

INITIALIZING.notes: Normal startup goes to IDLE. If heater not ready, can go to HEATING.

IDLE.notes: Main waiting state. Can start scanning on cartridge insert, go to heating if temp drops, or upload cached results.

HEATING.notes: Waiting for heater. Can scan barcode during heating (early detection). Cartridges inserted during heating are REJECTED.

BARCODE_SCANNING.notes: After barcode read, determines cartridge type and routes accordingly.

VALIDATING_CARTRIDGE.notes: Cloud validation. Has 45s timeout with 3 retries and exponential backoff.

VALIDATING_MAGNETOMETER.notes: BLE magnetometer validation. Terminal state - only returns to IDLE.

RUNNING_TEST.notes: Test execution via BCODE. Goes to UPLOADING_RESULTS on completion, IDLE if cancelled.

UPLOADING_RESULTS.notes: Cloud upload. Has 30s timeout. Returns to IDLE when complete or failed.

RESETTING_CARTRIDGE.notes: Cloud reset request. Has 30s timeout. Returns to IDLE when complete.

STRESS_TESTING.notes: Automated testing cycles. Only exits to IDLE.

ERROR_STATE.notes: Error condition. Can only recover to IDLE after clearing error.

alwaysAllowed.toErrorState: Can ALWAYS transition to ERROR_STATE from any state (safety mechanism)
alwaysAllowed.toIdle: Can ALWAYS transition to IDLE from any state (reset/cleanup mechanism)

userStories.title: Implement hardware_loop() function

acceptanceCriteria: Updates heater_ready based on temperature delta from target

Handles buzzer alert/problem triggers

userStories.title: Implement validation retry logic with exponential backoff
userStories.description: Implement cartridge validation retry with proper timeout and backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Default timeout is 45000ms (VALIDATION_TIMEOUT_MS)
Maximum timeout is 60000ms (VALIDATION_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS)
Maximum retries is 3 (VALIDATION_MAX_RETRIES)
Backoff delay is VALIDATION_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE (5000ms) multiplied by retry count
On timeout: increment retry count, calculate backoff, clear cloud operation
On max retries exceeded: set cartridge_state to INVALID, set error, clear tracking
On cloud disconnect during validation: count as retry with backoff
Verify cartridge still present before retry
Log retry attempts with remaining delay
userStories.notes: Implemented in main.ino VALIDATING_CARTRIDGE case. 45s timeout, 3 retries, exponential backoff (5s base).
